title: kubecompute/create-host input
description: Build one converge-able host (ADR-0151). authorizedKeysSecret is a POINTER to a Secret holding authorized_keys and never material (§2.5) — the build mounts it, so the key that lets Stratt reach the host is the one the estate already brokers; nothing is minted, logged, or written to the graph here. It is REQUIRED because a host built with no authorized key is running and unreachable, which is precisely the floci failure this provider exists not to repeat.

name.description: The instance the Intent fanned out to — the host's name and its identity.

authorizedKeysSecret.description: Name of a Secret in the build namespace with an `authorized_keys` key. A pointer, never material.

labels.description: Labels the built host carries, including the Intent's built-marker (ADR-0120) that the provisioning reconcile matches to decide this instance is built.

projectKind.description: The Entity kind the build projects (ADR-0058 M1). Defaults to `host` when unset — the only kind this substrate makes.

placement.description: Declared topology placement (ADR-0123 D2). ACCEPTED AND UNUSED on this substrate: a pod is placed by the Kubernetes scheduler, not by the estate. It is accepted rather than refused so the shared Intent/Compute launch interface stays shared across providers, and the plugin EMITS an event when a non-empty placement is ignored — an ignored declaration must be visible, not silent (§1.8, and the ADR-0123 D3 rule that a dropped input is how `placement` reached no provider for as long as it did).

params.description: Opaque provider build params (ADR-0110). This provider needs none — a host is defined by its name, its image and its authorized keys — so they are accepted and unused, and a non-empty set is reported for the same reason placement is.
